# testdata

**Tag**: testing, data

## 简介

A test framework which accepts test data in a Polyrex format.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/jrobertson/testdata
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/testdata/1.1.13
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/testdata
